main_vs_classical_queue.description: Anti-artifact paired contrast against a classical queue baseline.

main_vs_uniform_backend_quality.description: Primary attribution contrast for backend heterogeneity.

main_vs_no_coexecution_sensitivity.description: Primary attribution contrast for co-execution sensitivity.

main_vs_no_calibration_drift.description: Secondary contrast used to justify calibration drift downgrade.

main_vs_topology_insensitive.description: Secondary contrast used to justify topology-related non-monotonicity.

main_vs_compile_path_neutralized.description: Compile-path contrast testing whether backend-aware compilation and eligibility structure materially shape timing distinguishability.

main_vs_noise_flattened.description: Noise-shaping contrast testing whether backend noise and crosstalk-like variation materially shape timing distinguishability.

main_vs_coarse_observability.description: Observability-abstraction contrast against coarse-grained scheduler-visible output.

main_vs_masked_backend_only.description: Observability-abstraction contrast that hides backend identity but preserves wait and queue signals.

main_vs_queue_length_only.description: Observability-abstraction contrast that preserves only queue-length-side information.
